name: Morning Grace Secondary Workflows

readingPlan.rule: factual progress only; no streak or debt framing

prayerDetail.rule: request and story before administrative metadata

prayerAdministration.rule: forms remain clear but visually subordinate to devotional content

focusedPrayer.rule: minimal navigation, botanical cue, one dominant Prayed Next action

search.primarySurface: prominent local search with grouped results
search.rule: result text uses reading typography where useful

data.primarySurface: privacy, export, backup and validated restore
data.rule: restrained utility styling; destructive actions remain explicit

visualRules: secondary screens inherit Morning Grace typography, color, borders, and motifs
utility workflows are calmer than canonical screens and use less artwork
devotional content receives more visual weight than administration
forms use paper surfaces and fine rules rather than dashboard cards
no spiritual gamification or productivity jargon
destructive and restore operations remain visually explicit

responsive.desktop: editorial master-detail with sticky context where existing behavior supports it
responsive.textResize: 200 percent reflows to one column without horizontal overflow

behaviorPreservation: reflection revision and draft protection unchanged
M'Cheyne import and completion semantics unchanged
prayer conflict protection and lifecycle semantics unchanged
search corpus and local personal search unchanged
